dslRule:
<!id: eclipse.jdt.ui.module_image_rename>
<!description: Update module icon name from 'module_obj.png' to 'module_attrib.png'. This is specific to the Eclipse JDT UI plugin for modularity details.>
<!severity: INFO>

org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.createUnManaged($arg1, "module_obj.png")
=>
org.eclipse.jdt.internal.ui.JavaPluginImages.createUnManaged($arg1, "module_attrib.png")
;;
